manaNeeded: {4}{W} and {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Wormfang Drake must be exiled by Lumbering Battlement, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lumbering Battlement by paying {4}{W}.
When Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Wormfang Drake to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Lumbering Battlement to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
